name: ouro
description: A local menu bar calendar for macOS — read your schedule, find free time, and propose events and errands that you approve in the app.
long_description:
Connects to the installed Ouro app (a calendar that lives only on this Mac). Claude can read events and free time, and **propose** events or errands — a message your Claude Code or Codex runs at a set time. Nothing is added or run until you approve the card in the Ouro popover; private events are never shared.

This extension contains no executable. It verifies and runs the signed, notarized binary inside the installed Ouro.app. Install Ouro first: https://github.com/dinggi5/ouro

tools.name: get_agenda
tools.description: Events between two local dates (read only; private events are hidden)

tools.name: find_free_time
tools.description: Free gaps of a given length inside working hours (read only)

tools.name: propose_event
tools.description: Propose an event — it is added only when you approve the card in Ouro

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Status of an event proposal (read only)

tools.name: propose_errand
tools.description: Propose an errand (a message Claude Code or Codex runs later) — runs only after you approve it in Ouro

tools.name: get_errand_proposal
tools.description: Status of an errand proposal (read only)
